programme.desc: మతప్రబోధకుడు చిక్కం ఇస్సాక్ వివిధ బైబిల్ బోధనలపై ప్రసంగం ఇస్తూ, భక్తులను అదే విషయాన్ని ప్రతిబింబించేలా ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: వేకెంట్
programme.desc: అత్యుత్తమ టెలివిజన్ కార్యక్రమాలు.

programme.title: పి జి స్టీఫెన్ పాల్
programme.desc: పి జె స్టీఫెన్ పాల్ పవిత్ర బైబిలులోని శ్లోకాలను చదువుతూ ప్రసంగించి, అనుచరులను నీతివంతమైన జీవితం గడపమని ప్రోత్సహిస్తారు.

programme.title: జేసీఎన్ఎం కె. శ్యామ్ కిషోర్

programme.title: సిస్టర్ జాయ్ చెరియన్

programme.title: Fantastic Four
programme.desc: After being exposed to cosmic radiation, four astronauts gain unique powers and must navigate personal tensions while confronting an increasingly dangerous adversary.

programme.title: Bruce Almighty
programme.desc: A furious TV reporter demands an explanation from God for the injustice done to him. Soon, the Almighty gives him the power to run the world for a while, to teach him how difficult it is.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: King Of Serpant
programme.desc: A man's small village faces certain death unless he kills a giant python. So, he leads the hunt against the beast to keep his village safe.

programme.title: Free Fall
programme.desc: Marie meets skydiver Maxime, who unbeknownst to her is a thief. After his boss Sophia sabotages Marie's parachute, she miraculously survives a 3,000-metre fall and seeks revenge on them.

programme.title: The Devil Wears Prada
programme.desc: A smart but sensible new graduate lands a job as an assistant to Miranda Priestly, the demanding editor-in-chief of a high fashion magazine.

programme.title: Maleficent
programme.desc: Maleficent is a kind-hearted fairy who is deceived by the love of her life, Stefan. However, she lands in a dilemma after she places a curse on his daughter, Aurora, in order to exact revenge.

programme.title: Winnie the Pooh
programme.desc: Three stories inspired by A.A. Milne add up to a very busy day for Winnie-the-Pooh and friends. Upon learning that Eeyore has lost his tail, the residents of the Hundred Acre Wood start a contest to see who can find a new one for the melancholy donkey -- with a pot of honey going to the winner. Amid the goings-on, Owl mistakenly relates the news that Christopher Robin has been abducted. However, all ends well when Pooh finds a land of sweet delights.

programme.title: Alien: Covenant
programme.desc: Covenant, a colony ship, receives a radio transmission from a planet, leading the crew to go on a mission to explore it. However, things get complicated when they encounter deadly aliens.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
programme.desc: Peter Quill, a space adventurer, steals a powerful orb sought after by an evil villain called Ronan the Accuser who wants the universe under his rule.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: Aladdin, a lovable street urchin, teams up with a powerful, wisecracking genie to save the kingdom of Agrabah, and its beautiful princess Jasmine from the evil grand vizier Jafar.

programme.title: Con Air
programme.desc: Cameron Poe, a wrongly convicted parolee, travels in a flight to go home. However, trouble knocks on the door when the flight is hijacked by some dangerous criminals.

programme.title: BlackBerry
programme.desc: Mike Lazaridis and his best friend Douglas Fregin attempt to revolutionise the communications industry with the world's first smartphone. However, the pair finds themselves jumping several hurdles.

programme.title: Black Widow
programme.desc: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, is faced with the challenge of addressing a sensitive issue from her past when a potential threat emerges linked to her history.

programme.title: Night at the Museum: Battle of the Smithsonian
programme.desc: When Pharaoh Kahmunrah plots to create chaos at the Smithsonian Museum, Larry disguises himself as the night guard to save his friends, who have been mistakenly shipped to the museum.

programme.title: Breaking Infinity
programme.desc: Time-jumping scientist Liam, guided by a mysterious elder, travels to a future where he sees global destruction he might have caused.

programme.title: Ooops! Noah Is Gone ...
programme.desc: During an apocalyptic flood, Finny and Leah, a couple of animals, join other creatures on Noah's Ark. However, they fall overboard and struggle for survival.

programme.title: A Knight's War
programme.desc: A courageous knight embarks on a perilous mission to save a woman's soul. However, he is soon confronted with the unexpected and disturbing aftermath of her return.

programme.title: Filler
programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Samson
programme.desc: Samson, a Nazirite, takes on the role of rescuing Israelites from the oppression. However, he soon finds himself caught up in the evil machinations of a prince, which leads him to seek revenge.

programme.title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
programme.desc: Tang Sanzang, a Buddhist, decides to free a fishing village of demons it is plagued by. He teams up with Miss Duan, a demon hunter, and begins to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Mutant Python
programme.desc: A python is determined to exact revenge on a secluded village in the northern Fujian district of China after its altar is desecrated by a dead snake.

programme.title: Finding Nemo
programme.desc: With the help of a forgetful fish, Marlin, a clown fish, embarks on a journey to find his son, Nemo, after losing him in the Great Barrier Reef.

programme.title: The Pacifier
programme.desc: Shane Wolfe, a Navy SEAL, fails to rescue a government scientist, Howard Plummer, from Serbian rebels. Later, he is assigned to protect Plummer's children from his enemies.

programme.title: Detective Di Skeleton General
programme.desc: A village community is left reeling from the brutality of a series of mysterious killings, leading a renowned detective of the era to investigate in search of the truth.

programme.title: Ice Age: Dawn of the Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Sid invites trouble by stealing three eggs from a dinosaur causing his friends Manny, Ellie, who is pregnant and Diego to help him return them home.

programme.title: Stinky Summer
programme.desc: Olivia and her friends, along with a lovable skunk at Camp Clover as they strive to protect her father’s secret invention.

programme.title: Dead Poets Society
programme.desc: John Keating, a progressive English teacher, tries to encourage his students to break free from the norm, go against the status quo and live life unapologetically.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Shan, a beautiful mermaid, is sent on a mission to kill Liu Xuan, a business tycoon. However, complications arise when they develop feelings for each other.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: When an ice queen accidentally plunges her kingdom into an eternal winter, her sister decides to bring warmth back to the kingdom.

programme.title: Frozen II
programme.desc: Elsa's quest takes her into a magical forest alongside Anna, Kristoff and Olaf as they unravel secrets about her powers and Arendelle's destiny.

programme.title: షాక్

programme.desc: இளைஞன் வங்கியாளரின் வாழ்வில் குழப்பத்தை ஏற்படுத்துகிறான். முதலாளியுடனான இன்னலில் இளைஞரின் அணுகுமுறை மேலும் சிக்கலாகிறது.

programme.title: உங்களுக்காக ஒருவன்

programme.desc: நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள பல அரசியல் மற்றும் சமூக-பொருளாதார பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான சமீபத்திய செய்திகள் மற்றும் முன்னேற்றங்கள்.

programme.title: விடியலே வா
programme.desc: உடற்பயிற்சி, தொழில்நுட்பம், நிதி, சமூகம், பொருளாதாரம் மற்றும் கலாச்சாரம் தொடர்பான பல்வேறு தலைப்புகள் குறித்த தகவல்கள்.

programme.title: ஸ்நேகிதியே
programme.desc: வீடு மற்றும் வாழ்க்கை முறை குறிப்புகளுடன் பெண்களின் பிரச்சினைகள் தொடர்பான தலைப்புகளில் விவாதங்களில் ஈடுபடுகிறது.

programme.title: அழகி
programme.desc: விதவை சுந்தரியின் மூன்று மகன்களில் ஒருவரான நட்ராஜ் பணக்கார பெண்ணை மணக்கும்போது குடும்பத்தில் விஷயங்கள் மோசமாகிறது.

programme.title: கற்றது சமையல்
programme.desc: எண்ணற்ற சுவையான சமையல் குறிப்புகளை வழங்குவதோடு, அவற்றை சமைத்து காண்பித்து மேலும், பயனுள்ள சமையல் குறிப்புகளை பகிர்கிறது.

programme.title: கோலங்கள்
programme.desc: கடின உழைப்பாளியான அபிநயா, தன்னைச் சுற்றியுள்ளவர்களால் பல கஷ்டங்களைச் சந்திக்கிறாள், அவளுடைய மாற்றாந்தாய் ஆதித்யா உட்பட.

programme.title: தென்றல்

programme.desc: சொந்த மகளை இழந்த வினோத் மற்றும் லட்சுமி, டினுவை தத்தெடுத்தனர், அவளின் சொந்த பெற்றோர் வருகையில் சிக்கலை சந்தித்தனர்.

programme.desc: உலகின் வெப்பமான பகுதிகளில் ஏற்படும் காலநிலை மாற்றம், மாறிவரும் சூழலுக்கு விலங்குகள் தங்களை மாற்றிக் கொள்வதை பற்றி அறிக.
